name: DeleteMailFolder
description: Deletes a specified mail folder and its contents from a mailbox using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialName__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the request. The credential must have permission to delete mailbox folders.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The email address of the mailbox containing the folder to delete.

fields.name: FolderName
fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: The display name of the folder to delete. This folder and all its contents will be permanently removed from the mailbox.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the folder deletion operation, including success status and any error messages.
